description: Prepares an estimate (or, with estimateType QUOTE, a fixed-price quote) for a customer as a draft: customer, date, valid-until date, lines with amounts, and taxes. A new customer name is added to the books. It is NOT sent: the user reviews it and sends it from Mobile Accounting; once the customer accepts, it becomes an invoice there. It is created as a DRAFT: nothing is posted, paid or sent. Tell the user it is waiting for them in Mobile Accounting (openInApp).

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

currency.description: ISO currency when not the books' own.

customer.description: The customer, by name (find_contacts lists the existing ones).

estimateType.description: ESTIMATE (the price may change, the default) or QUOTE (a fixed price).

lines.description: The work or goods being priced, before tax.

category.description: Or a category name, matched exactly (optional).

description.description: What it was for (for example "Printer paper").

notes.description: Terms or a note the customer reads on the estimate.

reference.description: The business's own estimate number or a reference.

taxes.description: Each tax to charge (GST, HST, PST, sales tax...).

label.description: The tax as printed (GST, HST, PST, QST, VAT, sales tax...).

total.description: The expected total, to check the lines and taxes add up.

validUntil.description: Valid until, yyyy-MM-dd (default 30 days after the date).

name: create_estimate
title: Create an estimate or quote (draft)
